events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Nathan Church and Masyn Winn hit three-run homers and the St. Louis Cardinals had 17 hits overall to cool off the Chicago Cubs 17-1 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan Church and Masyn Winn hit 3-run HRs, Cardinals pound Cubs 17-1

headlines.description: — Luis García Jr. and Daylen Lile each homered twice, and José Tena also went deep for Washington as the Nationals beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 9-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: García and Lile each homer twice as the Nationals rout the Pirates 9-5

events.name: Minnesota Twins at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Ben Rice hit a go-ahead two-run homer in the third inning after a rain delay and the New York Yankees ended a seven-game losing streak with a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ben Rice hits go-ahead 2-run homer as Yankees stop 7-game skid with 5-2 victory over Twins

headlines.description: — Samuel Basallo hit a two-run homer and Trevor Rogers pitched out of trouble for five innings as the Baltimore Orioles beat the Cincinnati Reds 3-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Samuel Basallo hits 2-run homer to back Trevor Rogers as Orioles blank Reds 3-0

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Khalil Watson singled home the winning run in the 10th inning and the Cleveland Guardians rallied for a 4-3 victory over the Chicago White Sox on Friday night to move into first place in the AL Central.
headlines.shortLinkText: Khalil Watson's single in the 10th inning gives the Guardians a 4-3 win over the White Sox

events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Matt Olson hit two home runs, Michael Harris II added a two-run shot, and Ozzie Albies also homered as the Atlanta Braves cranked up their power game to beat the New York Mets 5-3...
headlines.shortLinkText: Olson hits 2 homers, Harris and Albies also go deep as Braves roll to 5-3 win over struggling Mets

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Jake McCarthy got Colorado started with a leadoff homer, hit a grand slam in a seven-run fifth and drove in a career-high six runs in the Rockies' 15-3 romp over the San Francisco Giants on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake McCarthy hits 2 HRs, drives in 6 runs in the Rockies' 15-3 romp over the Giants

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Nick Fortes homered and hit a run-scoring double, Junior Caminero added a solo shot, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the Houston Astros 3-1 on Friday night to extend the longest active win streak in the major leagues to nine games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fortes, Caminero hit HRs, Rays beat Astros 3-1 for 9th straight win

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Aroldis Chapman set the major league record for relief strikeouts after rookie Jake Bennett yielded five hits while pitching into the eighth inning for the Boston Red Sox in a 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Aroldis Chapman sets relief Ks record, Red Sox rookie Jake Bennett stifles Angels in 5-2 win

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers hit two home runs in a 4-for-5 night, Heriberto Hernández, Jakob Marsee and Owen Caissie also homered and the Miami Marlins beat the Athletics 12-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stowers hits 2 of the Marlins' 5 HRs in a 12-5 win over the A's

headlines.description: — Jackson Chourio's slow roller scored the go-ahead run in the 11th inning and the Milwaukee Brewers went on to beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 7-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chourio's scratch hit in 11th breaks tie, Brewers top Diamondbacks 7-4

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Teoscar Hernández hit a go-ahead grand slam off reliever Adrian Morejon in the seventh inning, and the Los Angeles Dodgers rallied for the second straight game to beat the San Diego Padres 4-3 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teoscar Hernández’s 7th-inning grand slam sparks another Dodgers rally vs Padres

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Dylan Cease struck out nine in seven sharp innings to pitch the Toronto Blue Jays past the Seattle Mariners 2-0 on Friday night in a rematch of last year's American League Championship Series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dylan Cease strikes out 9 in 7 innings as Blue Jays blank Mariners 2-0 in ALCS rematch
